text:
ashley-ng: Quick sync — following the model-registry + cloud-auth blip last night we need a short remediation tracker that focuses on ownership coverage and run-rate (recurrence window).
sana-k: Agree. Root PM said vendor auth latency spikes roughly every 48–72h. We should treat it as a repeating transient until we have a durable mitigator.
leo: Can we map current mitigations -> owners? My list: 1) model-registry rollback script (sana), 2) auth fallback token cache (frank), 3) cross-region routing policy (ops). Missing: automated circuit breaker + alert classification.
frank-m: Confirming I'll own the fallback cache and add TTL smoothing. ETA EOD Tue. I'll add a quick healthcheck endpoint so the router can detect auth degradation earlier.
ash (incident-bot): Postmortem created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-4523 — summary: "auth provider latency -> partial failures for model loading".
ash (incident-bot): Postmortem severity: Sev3. Action items assigned automatically to owners list.
nash (oncall-ops): Small ask — can owners include a 'coverage window' in the tracker (hours/day) so we can rotate handoffs? E.g., primary + backup + escalation contact.
nash (ashley-ng): Yes. New column: primary | backup | backup_contact | rotation_cadence. Let's pick cadence initially: weekly for infra owners; daily for on-call during runway.
sana-k: I'll update the doc. Also propose adding a metric to detect the pattern: 95th auth latency over 30m moving window spike count. If spike_count > 3 in 24h -> automated paging to SRE.
leo: Add a short playbook snippet for runbook automation. Example:
```yaml
trigger: auth_latency_spike
conditions:
  - window: 30m
    p95_auth_latency_ms: ">= 1200"
actions:
  - notify: #incidents
  - run: switch-routing-to-region(us-west-2)
  - run: enable-token-cache
```
frank-m: Will wire the healthcheck + a small webhook that incident router uses. When healthcheck fails 3x in 5m, router marks provider unhealthy and routes to fallback. ETA Thu.
nash (oncall-ops): We should avoid full fail-open for model-registry. Instead prefer degraded mode: smaller batch sizes + read-from-cache. That reduces tail impact.
nash (ashley-ng): Good call. Action items summary (please ack):
- Sana: update tracker with coverage columns + add metric definition (ETA 24h)
- Frank: healthcheck + webhook + fallback cache smoothing (ETA Thu)
- Leo: draft playbook snippet and add KB section on degraded serving mode (ETA Wed)
- Oncall: add alert rule and runbook link to PagerDuty escalation (ETA EOD Mon)
nash (sana-k): Ack. I'll put owners & coverage into the tracker now: https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/auth-patterns-tracker
nash (frank-m): Ack. Will link the healthcheck PR once ready.
leo: Ack, will PR playbook and include test checklist (local sim + dry-run routing).
nash (ashley-ng): One more: let's set a recurring 30-min digest for the next 2 weeks for this tracker (automated slack summary). ops-bot can post daily status: progress + regressions.
nash (incident-bot): Scheduled message created: daily @ 09:30 to #incidents for two weeks.
nash (oncall-ops): Also request that product/legal review the vendor SLA capture — we may push for an SLO/credits clause if this continues.
nash (ashley-ng): Noted. I'll loop in roth@ and legal. If any owner needs help hitting ETA, ping me in-thread. :thumbsup:
